speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have some skin concerns we need to address; please describe any rashes, lumps, or changing moles you have noticed, including their size, color, and how long they have been present. To help narrow this down, have you experienced any itching, pain, or bleeding from these areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (penile and cutaneous)
